policy_metadata.policy_name: Consumer Washing Machine Warranty Policy - Pakistan Region
policy_metadata.jurisdiction: Punjab Consumer Protection Act 2005 / Sindh Consumer Protection Act 2014 & Federal Standards

applicable_subcategories: Fully Automatic Front-Load Inverter Washing Machine
Fully Automatic Top-Load Inverter Washing Machine

warranty_start_conditions.primary_trigger: Date of verified retail purchase invoice issued by an authorized dealer
warranty_start_conditions.commissioning_requirement: For fully automatic inverter front-load and top-load units, warranty requires documented installation and electrical earthing verification by an authorized service franchisee within 14 calendar days of delivery
prerequisites: Original sales invoice with registered Sales Tax (STRN) or National Tax Number (NTN)
Official distributor warranty card stamped and signed by an authorized retail dealer
Valid electrical earthing / ground connection verified at the customer's installation socket

covered_faults: Inverter Direct Drive / Smart Inverter motor electrical failure (stator winding burn, hall sensor defect, rotor detachment under normal load)
Main electronic controller / inverter drive PCB failure (logic crash, error codes E1, E2, E3, OE, DE, IGBT module burnout under rated voltage)
Water inlet solenoid valve mechanical seizure or coil burnout
Drain pump motor electrical failure or impeller spindle fracture
Electronic door safety interlock lock/switch failure
Suspension damper and balance spring mechanical fatigue (excluding overload collapse)
Internal heating element open-circuit / thermistor sensor calibration failure
Drum spider bracket structural fracture under manufacturer-specified wash weight
exclusions: Electrical surge, spike, or lightning strike damage resulting from direct connection to AC mains without an automated 15A voltage stabilizer or surge protector where grid voltage exceeds 260V or drops below 160V
Operation using modified square-wave uninterruptible power supplies (UPS) or substandard local portable generators lacking pure sine wave output
Chewed electrical harnesses, shorted control boards, or debris accumulation caused by rodent, insect, cockroach, or lizard infestation inside the base cabinet
Excessive limescale buildup, calcium encrustation, or chemical corrosion on heating coils, valves, and inner tub caused by high-TDS saline/brackish groundwater exceeding 1200 PPM
Commercial, institutional, or communal use (e.g. laundromat, hostel, beauty salon, hospital, hotel, or daily domestic cycles exceeding 4 runs per day)
External body dents, scratch damage, rusted base plate resulting from continuous standing water, transit damages, or broken cosmetic plastic lids/filters
Drain pump or outer tub mechanical lockup caused by foreign objects (coins, hairpins, nails, bra underwires, buttons) trapped in the lint filter chamber
Any unauthorized disassembly, PCB component re-soldering, or motor rewinding carried out by independent bazaar technicians (e.g. Hall Road, Saddar, local electrical shops)

repair_conditions.spare_parts_origin: 100% Genuine OEM factory-certified spare parts sourced through authorized national distributor depots
repair_conditions.in_home_vs_depot: Standard faults are rectified on-site at the consumer's premises. If drum spider replacement, tub bearing replacement, or complex PCB bench diagnostic is required, the unit or sub-assembly will be transported to the regional central workshop
repair_conditions.repaired_parts_post_warranty_policy: Parts replaced under paid non-warranty service carry a 90-day functional warranty from the date of repair completion

authorized_service_centre_requirement.mandate: All warranty inspections, diagnostics, and repairs must be executed strictly by certified brand Authorized Service Center (ASC) personnel possessing official digital job cards
authorized_service_centre_requirement.unauthorized_service_penalty: Immediate cancellation and voiding of the remaining warranty term if third-party tamper seals are broken or non-OEM screws/wiring splices are detected
authorized_service_centre_requirement.territorial_coverage: Doorstep on-site warranty coverage applies to all tier-1 and tier-2 cities across Pakistan (Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad/Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar, Gujranwala, Quetta, Sialkot, Hyderabad, Sukkur). Remote tier-3 locations may require scheduling with regional mobile technical squads

replacement_conditions.doa_conditions: Dead on Arrival (DOA) or catastrophic functional failure occurring within 14 calendar days of delivery, verified by an authorized technician, provided the unit exhibits zero cosmetic scratches and includes original packaging
replacement_conditions.unresolved_repeat_failure_condition: Failure of the same primary sub-assembly (Inverter Motor or Main Inverter PCB) occurring 3 consecutive times within the initial 6 months of operation
replacement_conditions.parts_backorder_condition: Inability of the authorized national parts depot to supply critical functional replacement parts within 30 consecutive calendar days from technical diagnostic approval
replacement_conditions.replacement_tier: Exact identical model, or a current-generation equivalent model with matching or superior technical specifications if the original model has been discontinued

mandatory_documents: Original Retail Purchase Invoice bearing official dealer stamp, customer name, date of purchase, model, serial number, and NTN/STRN
Original Brand Warranty Card bearing retailer's physical stamp and signature
Authorized Service Installation and Commissioning Job Sheet (mandatory for front-load inverter models)
Clear photograph of the rear rating plate displaying serial barcode and manufacturing date
National Identity Card (CNIC) copy of the registered purchaser

hard_fail_rules.description: Appliance operated in a commercial, communal, or industrial facility; domestic warranty completely voided.

hard_fail_rules.condition: tamper_seal_broken == true || third_party_repair_evidence == true || non_oem_wiring_splice == true
hard_fail_rules.description: Appliance disassembled, repaired, or modified by unauthorized local workshop technicians.
Wiring loom chewed by rats or PCB short-circuited by insects/lizards inside the cabinet.

hard_fail_rules.condition: external_cabinet_dented == true || outer_tub_fracture_impact == true || transit_drop_evidence == true
hard_fail_rules.description: Physical, accidental, or transit drops and structural impacts are excluded from warranty coverage.

hard_fail_rules.rule_name: Warranty Period Expired with Grace Exhaustion
hard_fail_rules.description: Claim registered more than 15 calendar days after the expiration of the comprehensive warranty duration.

hard_fail_rules.rule_name: Unprotected Power Surge on Non-Stabilized Mains
hard_fail_rules.description: Catastrophic PCB surge burnout caused by operating directly on high-fluctuation AC mains without an automated 15A voltage stabilizer.

hard_fail_rules.rule_name: Missing Proof of Purchase and Warranty Card
hard_fail_rules.description: Claim cannot be verified without either the original stamped warranty card or verifiable GST invoice.

warning_rules.warning_message: Water source exhibits high TDS (>1000 PPM). Mineral descaling required; future valve/heater failures from scale will be billable.
warning_rules.action_required: Issue water softener recommendation and document current descaling charge status on job card.

warning_rules.warning_message: Claim filed within the 15-day post-expiry grace period. Proof of initial symptom occurrence date required.
warning_rules.action_required: Technician must inspect fault telemetry logs on digital inverter PCB to confirm fault manifested prior to expiry date.

warning_rules.warning_message: Fault reported after the 7-day reporting window. Assess unit for secondary consequential damage caused by delayed reporting.
warning_rules.action_required: Verify that delayed operation with fault did not cause motor stator overheat or tub bearing destruction.

warning_rules.condition: subcategory == 'Fully Automatic Front-Load Inverter Washing Machine' && installation_job_sheet_available == false
warning_rules.warning_message: Front-load unit missing authorized commissioning slip. Transit bolts must be verified prior to diagnostic.
warning_rules.action_required: Technician must physically confirm transit shipping bolts were properly removed and drum rotates freely.

warning_rules.rule_name: Drain Impeller Blocked by Foreign Objects
warning_rules.warning_message: Drain pump jammed by coins, hairpins, or debris. Pump motor is functional; cleaning fee applicable.
warning_rules.action_required: Perform foreign object extraction; bill customer standard servicing fee while preserving electrical warranty.

manual_review_trigger_rules.trigger_reason: DOA unit replacement requested within first 14 days of purchase.
manual_review_trigger_rules.review_department: Regional Quality Assurance & Dealer Claims Desk

manual_review_trigger_rules.trigger_reason: Recurring failure of core inverter assemblies indicates systemic customer grid voltage issue or manufacturing batch defect.
OEM spare part (e.g. inverter control kit or drum assembly) unavailable at national warehouse exceeding 21 days.

manual_review_trigger_rules.rule_name: Repair Cost Approaching Replacement Value Threshold
manual_review_trigger_rules.trigger_reason: Cumulative repair estimate exceeds 60% of original invoice value; review for commercial replacement vs repair.

manual_review_trigger_rules.rule_name: Grid Surge Dispute with Power Utility (WAPDA/K-Electric)
manual_review_trigger_rules.trigger_reason: Customer disputes power surge assessment claiming grid stabilizer was operational during utility fault.
